info.title: performanceManagement
info.description: The Performance Management service enables applications to access and create feedback about workers in the system.

tags.name: feedbackBadges
tags.description: Provides the ability to get available feedback badges for use in providing feedback.

get.summary: (End of Life Date: 2024-01-26 ) Retrieves a collection of workers.
get.description: Retrieves all workers. Use the search parameter to search for workers by name. The search is case-insensitive. Secured By Domain: FLW Service, Self-Service: Current Staffing Information, Worker Data: Public Worker Reports Scope: Staffing

parameters.name: includeTerminatedWorkers
parameters.description: Include terminated workers in the output

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of objects in a single response. The default is 20. The maximum is 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The zero-based index of the first object in a response collection. The default is 0. Use offset with the limit parameter to control paging of a response collection. Example: If limit is 5 and offset is 9, the response returns a collection of 5 objects starting with the 10th object.

200.description: Successful response. A successful response can return no matched data.

post.summary: (End of Life Date: 2024-01-26 ) Creates feedback about the specified worker.
post.description: Creates a single feedback given instance with the specified data. In the request body, specify at least this required field: comment. This endpoint is equivalent to the Give Feedback task in Workday and initiates the Give Feedback business process. Secured By Business Process Type: Give Feedback Scope: Performance Enablement, Worker Profile and Skills

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description:
The Workday ID of the resource.

- **ID:** Replace with your actual Workday ID
- **me**

400.description:
Invalid request. (https://community.workday.com/rest/error-messages)
| Severity | Error Code | Validation Message |
 --- | --- | --- |
| Critical | A6 | Comment is required. |
| Critical | A158 | Feedback Badges are disabled, cannot include Feedback Badges in feedback. |
| Critical | A158 | The ability to submit confidential feedback has been disabled by your administrator. |
| Critical | A158 | The ability to submit private feedback has been disabled by your administrator. |
| Critical | A158 | Your tenant has disabled anonymity for anytime feedback. Showing the name of the responder is required. |
| Critical | A159 | Your feedback can’t be both Confidential and Private. |
| Critical | A160 | You don't have permission to give feedback on this Gig. |
| Critical | A161 | Feedback cannot be provided to terminated workers. |
| Critical | A161 | The Feedback Given Date cannot be in the future. |
| Critical | A161 | Worker giving the feedback cannot be the same as the worker receiving the feedback. |
| Critical | A161 | You can't give feedback for this \~worker\~ because they already have feedback. |
| Critical | A161 | You can't give feedback for this \~worker\~ because they're not a member of this Gig. |
| Critical | A161 | You can't load an inactive badge. |
